description: The file defines the EducationService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing education-related data such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and checking existence of education records. It interacts with the EducationDao data access object and handles entities related to education qualifications.

classes.name: EducationService
classes.description: Service class providing education data management functionalities such as CRUD operations and existence checks within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves an Education entity, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getEducationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EducationDao instance used for data access operations.

methods.name: setEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EducationDao instance, useful for dependency injection or testing.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education records matching specified search parameters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple Education records given their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks whether an Education name already exists in the system, case-insensitive.
